category_title: Students who engage in disruptive behavior to escape or avoid writing tasks
scenario_title: Extended writing process combined with skill deficits
minimal_context: Benjamin is sitting at his desk during independent work time to write a topic sentence and a detail sentence.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for independent work. Please write your topic sentence first, and then write your detail sentence.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Did you know Batman has a new car? It goes super fast! I want a car like that when I grow up.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need to work on writing right now. Go ahead and start.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't know what a topic sentence is. I can't spell any of these words. Did you know Superman can fly around the whole world in one minute?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just try your best to write one sentence on your paper.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Pushes the paper off the desk) I'm not doing this! I don't know how to do it and I'm not writing anything!

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: It is time for independent work. Please write your topic sentence first, and then write your detail sentence.

STUDENT: Did you know Batman has a new car? It goes super fast! I want a car like that when I grow up.

TUTOR: We need to work on writing right now. Go ahead and start.

STUDENT: I don't know what a topic sentence is. I can't spell any of these words. Did you know Superman can fly around the whole world in one minute?

TUTOR: Just try your best to write one sentence on your paper.

STUDENT: (Pushes the paper off the desk) I'm not doing this! I don't know how to do it and I'm not writing anything!

task.content: The writing process was broken into steps (i.e., topic sentence, detail sentence).

context.environment: Independent work time with a specific seating arrangement and proximity to teacher help.
context.materials: A communication system to request help with starting and completing writing tasks.

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: If work tasks were combined with skill deficits.
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Escalate forms of problem behavior to escape the task.
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Escaping the task was even more valuable.

behavior_patterns.condition: The longer he engaged in a writing task.
behavior_patterns.internal_state: His motivation to get out of the task increased.
